title: Business Sales Advisor - Customer Growth
description:
Customer Growth Advisor

Location: Manchester New Bailey

Start Date: 11/01/27

Build connections. Help businesses grow.

About BT Group

BT Group is the UK's leading communications group, bringing together some of the country's most recognised brands, including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is simple: we connect for good. From consumers and small businesses to large organisations, the public sector and other communications providers, we help our customers stay connected.

Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, we're focused on simplifying how we work, using technology and AI to work smarter, and serving customers better to grow sustainably. Our Group teams set direction, shape strategy and policy, and guide brand, capital allocation and transformation to help our businesses thrive.

We're customer-first challengers: committed, clear and connected. These behaviours bring us together as one team, delivering for our colleagues, customers, stakeholders and the country.

About the role

As a Customer Growth Advisor, you'll be the voice of BT for our small and medium business customers. You'll build genuine connections, understand their needs and recommend the right BT or EE Business products to help them succeed. Combining your sales experience with strong customer conversations, you'll help win new business, retain existing customers and identify opportunities to grow their relationship with us.

Depending on business needs, you'll handle a blend of inbound enquiries and outbound campaign calls, or work in an outbound-focused team. Outbound teams may also support inbound calls during busy periods, helping customers receive timely, high-quality service.

What you'll do
- Build trusted relationships by listening to customers and understanding their business needs and challenges.
- Recommend tailored BT and EE Business solutions through inbound enquiries and outbound campaigns.
- Retain customers, protect existing contracts and reduce customer churn through conversations focused on value.
- Identify opportunities to win new customers, upsell relevant products and grow existing accounts.
- Meet defined revenue, product volume and quality targets, spotting opportunities to exceed them.
- Respond to enquiries efficiently and appropriately, following agreed processes, procedures and compliance requirements.
- Support key customer programmes and adapt to changing demand, contributing to wider transformation and efficiency goals.
- Make every interaction a positive experience that reflects BT's reputation for trust, expertise and innovation.

What you'll bring
- Existing sales experience and a focus on delivering results against targets.
- Strong communication and listening skills, with the ability to build genuine customer connections.
- Commercial judgement to identify opportunities and recommend solutions that meet customer needs.
- A customer-first approach, balancing sales results with quality, compliance and long-term relationships.
- Flexibility to support inbound or outbound activity as business needs change.

Make a difference with BT

Join a business that matters to the UK and help small and medium businesses move forward. Through the conversations you have and the solutions you recommend, you'll strengthen long-term customer relationships and play a direct part in BT's future.

Ready to put your sales experience to work and help businesses grow? Apply for our Customer Growth Advisor role.

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Job description:

Inbound Sales Executive - Building Technology Manchester Basic salary + profit share

Monday-Thursday, 8 am-4 pm Friday, 8 am-3 pm.

Enjoy selling, but would rather spend your time speaking to and qualifying interested customers than cold calling?

An innovative building technology company in Manchester is looking for an energetic Sales Executive to join its small, busy team.

Its products have been exceptionally well received, and strong demand has created this new position.

This is a fully inbound sales role: no cold calling and no prospecting.

But it is much more than taking orders. The business needs someone who can listen carefully, qualify inquiries, and follow opportunities through to a sale.

The role

You'll help customers turn their initial interest into a clearly specified project and an order. Responsibilities include:
- Responding to inbound inquiries and establishing what customers need.
- Handling pre-booked calls to understand projects, ask relevant questions and qualify opportunities.
- Learning how to qualify customer for technical projects, with full product training and support.
- Following up quotes, answering questions and keeping opportunities moving.
- Closing sales and ensuring the details are correct when orders are placed.

You do not need to be an engineer or arrive with specialist product knowledge.

You do need the curiosity and attention to detail to learn how the products fit each customer's project.

The person

This would suit a proactive salesperson who enjoys being on the phone, listens properly and knows how to turn a good inquiry into a sale.

The key qualities are:
- Strong sales aptitude, with the drive and confidence to qualify opportunities thoroughly and ask for the order when appropriate.
- Energy, initiative and a willingness to take ownership of inquiries.
- Excellent listening skills.
- An eye for detail when gathering information and pre-qualifying the customer for the team producing the quotes.
- An organised approach to follow-up in a busy sales environment.
- A practical, hands-on attitude and an enthusiasm for learning.

Experience in technical, specification-led or project-based sales such as kitchen or security design lead type sales would be useful, but it is not essential.

Applications are welcome from good salespeople in any sector who can demonstrate these qualities.

What's on offer
- Basic salary plus profit share. We've shown only the base salary in the advertisement.
- Full product training.
- An established flow of inbound inquiries-no cold calling.
- A friendly, energetic and hands-on working culture.
- A small team where your contribution will be visible.
- A newly created role driven by business growth.
- Working hours of 8 am-4 pm Monday to Thursday and 8 am-3 pm Friday.

To apply, send your CV with a short note outlining your sales experience and what makes you a good fit for an inbound, project-led sales role.

Benefits:
- Company pension
- Free parking
- On-site parking
- Profit sharing

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Sales Development Representative

Salary: £25k plus monthly comms scheme

Locations: Manchester Based

Career progression: Structured development pathway into a Commercial Finance Broker role

The Opportunity

Funding Links is a fast-growing commercial finance brokerage based in Manchester, helping UK businesses access a broad range of funding solutions.

As we continue to expand, we're launching our Broker Academy, designed to develop ambitious salespeople into successful Commercial Finance Brokers.

We're looking for a highly motivated Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join the programme. This is an opportunity for someone looking to build a long-term career in commercial finance, with hands-on training, exposure to experienced brokers and a clear pathway into a full broking role.

The initial focus will be on outbound business development. We currently have approximately 4,000 leads in our CRM, alongside access to fresh B2 B prospecting data.

The successful candidate will proactively engage businesses, identify funding requirements, qualify opportunities and generate business for our New Business Brokers.

Alongside this, they'll develop an understanding of commercial finance products, lender criteria, deal structuring and the end-to-end funding process.

This is a sales-focused development role, not an administrative position.

Key Responsibilities
- Proactively contact businesses through our existing CRM database and new B2 B prospecting data.
- Re-engage previous funding enquiries and identify current or upcoming finance requirements.
- Conduct high-volume outbound calling to generate new business opportunities.
- Qualify prospects based on funding requirements, turnover, funding purpose and timescales.
- Book qualified appointments and introduce opportunities to our New Business Brokers.
- Maintain accurate CRM records, including call outcomes, qualification information and follow-up activity.
- Help segment and organise CRM data to improve the effectiveness of future outreach.
- Work closely with experienced brokers to understand funding products, lender requirements and deal progression.
- Develop the commercial knowledge and sales skills required to progress into a full Commercial Finance Broker role.
- Work towards agreed activity, qualification and revenue contribution targets.

Ideal Candidate

We're looking for someone with ambition, resilience and a genuine interest in building a successful sales career.
- Previous experience in outbound sales, telesales, SDR or business development would be advantageous.
- Confident and comfortable speaking with business owners and senior decision-makers.
- Highly motivated, competitive and driven by performance and earning potential.
- Resilient, proactive and comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.
- Excellent communication skills and a professional telephone manner.
- Organised and disciplined in managing CRM records and follow-up activity.
- Coachable, eager to learn and receptive to feedback.
- Interested in developing a long-term career in commercial finance.

Previous commercial finance experience is not essential. We're more interested in finding someone with the right attitude, work ethic and commercial aptitude who we can develop internally.

Broker Academy and Career Progression

Our intention is to develop successful SDRs into fully fledged Commercial Finance Brokers.

The successful candidate will receive:
- Hands-on coaching and mentoring from experienced commercial finance professionals.
- Training across our core funding products, including invoice finance, business loans, asset finance and trade finance.
- Exposure to the full funding lifecycle, from initial enquiry through to lender approval and completion.
- Opportunities to shadow brokers and participate in client conversations.
- Increasing responsibility as product knowledge, sales performance and confidence develop.
- A clear opportunity to progress into a Commercial Finance Broker position, subject to performance and demonstrated capability

What Success Looks Like

Initially, success will be measured by:
- Consistent outbound activity and meaningful conversations with business owners.
- Generating qualified funding opportunities from both existing CRM leads and new prospect data.
- Maintaining excellent CRM hygiene and follow-up discipline.
- Producing opportunities that progress through the sales pipeline and ultimately generate funded revenue.
- Demonstrating increasing product knowledge, commercial awareness and sales capability

description:

Manchester, UK Permanent Hybrid working

The successful candidate will combine strong client management skills with commercial awareness, strategic thinking and the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation.

As Client Services Director, you will play a key role in developing client relationships, identifying opportunities for growth and ensuring clients receive a high-quality, responsive and commercially focused service.

- Client relationship management: Develop and maintain trusted relationships with key clients, acting as a senior point of contact and understanding their business needs.
- Business development: Identify opportunities to grow existing client relationships, develop new business and contribute to the organisation's commercial objectives.
- Client service delivery: Ensure clients receive a consistent, high-quality service and that their expectations and priorities are understood.
- Strategic advice: Work with clients and internal specialists to identify challenges, provide appropriate solutions and support their longer-term objectives.
- Internal collaboration: Build effective working relationships across teams to coordinate services and deliver the best outcomes for clients.

We are looking for a confident, commercially aware professional who can combine strategic leadership with a hands-on approach to client relationship management.

You are likely to bring:
- Significant experience in a senior client-facing role within accountancy, professional services or a related environment.
- A strong track record of developing and maintaining senior client relationships.
- Commercial acumen and the ability to identify and convert business development opportunities.
- Excellent communication, influencing and relationship-building skills.
- The ability to understand complex client requirements and coordinate appropriate solutions.
- A collaborative approach, sound judgement and a commitment to delivering outstanding client service.

title: Customer Services Administrator
description:
Job Description

Start your career helping make investing feel good

We're looking for people who want to build a career, learn something new and make a difference to our customers.

As a Customer Services Administrator, you'll join one of our Client Servicing teams, helping customers with the things that matter to them. This could mean supporting investment transfers, processing pension benefits, helping with new business, supporting customers through bereavement, working with SIPP accounts or providing essential business support.

It's a broad role, with opportunities across different teams depending on our business needs, your interests and where your skills could make the biggest difference. Wherever you join, you'll be part of the team helping our customers manage their investments and pensions with confidence.

You don't need previous financial services experience to be successful. We'll give you the training, support and knowledge you need to build your confidence and develop your career from day one.

What you'll be doing

The work will vary depending on the team you join, but you'll be helping us deliver a great experience for our customers by:
- Processing customer requests accurately and efficiently
- Supporting customers with their investments, pensions and accounts
- Checking information, completing administrative processes and keeping records up to date
- Working with colleagues across AJ Bell to resolve queries and keep things moving
- Following processes and controls carefully to make sure customers are supported safely and correctly
- Learning about financial services and building your knowledge as you develop
- Looking for ways to improve how we work and make things simpler for our customers and colleagues

Some teams are more customer-facing, while others are focused on the operational work that happens behind the scenes. In every team, your work will contribute to delivering the service our customers rely on.

What we're looking for

We're looking for people who are curious, organised and keen to learn. You don't need to have worked in financial services before. We're more interested in your potential, your attitude and your ability to learn.

You'll bring:
- A minimum of 5 GCSEs at grades 9-4 (A -C), or equivalent, including Maths and English
- Good numerical ability and attention to detail
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Competent IT skills, including experience using Excel
- The ability to organise your workload, meet deadlines and work independently when needed
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn
- An interest in financial services and in helping us deliver a great experience for our customers

Previous experience in financial services, administration or customer service is helpful, but it's not essential. Full training and support will be provided.

Where could this role take you?

This is an opportunity to start building a long-term career at AJ Bell.

With opportunities across a range of Client Servicing teams, you'll have the chance to learn about different areas of our business and develop skills that can take you in many different directions.

You could start in one area and, as your knowledge and experience grow, explore new opportunities across Client Servicing or the wider business.

We're continuing to grow, with multiple opportunities available across our teams, and inductions for new starters taking place every three weeks.

About AJ Bell

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good.

Whether you're looking for an ISA, pension or dealing account, whether you want to invest with the help of a financial adviser or do it yourself, we have easy-to-use solutions to suit people from all walks of life.

We're one of the UK's fastest-growing investment platform businesses, trusted by everyone from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

Today, more than 762,000 customers trust us to manage over £121.5 billion in assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we're helping more people take control of their financial futures.

We're proud to be recognised as a Great Place to Work for the past two years, building on six consecutive years as one of the UK's Best 100 Companies to Work For. It's recognition we're proud of and a reflection of the supportive and collaborative culture we strive to create for our people.

What we offer
- Starting salary of £26,000, with the potential for a higher starting salary depending on relevant financial services experience
- 25 days' holiday, increasing with service, plus a buy/sell scheme and bank holidays
- 6% pension with matched contributions
- Discretionary bonus scheme
- Share schemes, including free shares and BAYE
- Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare
- Free onsite gym
- Enhanced family leave, subject to qualifying criteria
- Travel and bike loan schemes
- Employee Assistance Programme

Life at AJ Bell
- Regular social events, including summer and Christmas parties
- Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
- Casual dress code
- A friendly and supportive team environment

Our ways of working

At AJ Bell, our people are at the heart of our culture. We believe in building strong connections by working together.

Our Customer Services Administrator roles are hybrid, with 3-4 days per week in the office. For new team members, the first three months are spent full-time in the office. This gives you the opportunity to immerse yourself in the business, build your knowledge and get to know your colleagues as you settle into your role.

Inclusion & diversity

We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to be themselves at work.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

Your application, reviewed by people

We believe great hiring starts with people. That's why every application is reviewed by a member of our Recruitment team, rather than screened by AI. It may take us a few days to get back to you, but please be assured that your application will be given the time and attention it deserves.

Agency information

This vacancy is being managed exclusively by our in-house Recruitment team. We are not partnering with recruitment agencies on this opportunity and will only accept applications submitted directly by candidates.
